class.name: IfcPresentationStyleAssignment
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The presentation style assignment is a set of styles which are assigned to styled items for the purpose of presenting these styled items. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 name: presentation_style_assignment. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-46:1994 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY New entity in Release IFC2x2.
class.description: Only in IFC2X3 and IFC4 files.

members.member: A set of presentation styles that are assigned to styled items. An Array of values and GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 and IFC4 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
